instruction: You are Unable to Find The Desired Extension field in the Adaptation Mode for Arithmetic Calculation
input: Symptom You have created few extension fields on the Purchase Order  screen under Adaptation mode and want to add/create a calculated field using those extension fields but you are unable to find the desired extension fields for calculation. Environment SAP Business ByDesign Reproducing the Issue  Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center Select View Purchase Orders-> View All Navigate to Items Tab Open adaptation mode. In Items tab, select Business Context Purchase Order-Item Try to add a calculated field Enter the field type But you could not find the relevant extension fields for arithmetic calculation. Cause You have selected the wrong field type. Always check the field type of the relevant fields used in the calculation rule. Resolution Please select the correct field type so that you can see all the available extension fields. See Also https://blogs.sap.com/2015/03/17/customer-specific-extension-fields/ Keywords Extension fields, field type, calculated field, adaptation mode, extension field type
response: Please select the correct field type so that you can see all the available extension fields.

instruction: How to Populate Discount and Surcharge in Purchase Order Automatically?
input: Symptom You have created a purchase order and you are able to manually add discounts or surcharges. You want to know how this can be automatically populated in a purchase order. Environment SAP Business ByDesign Reproducing the Issue Go to Purchase Requests and Orders Select New Purchase Order under Common tasks  Select View All Enter the necessary details related to product, price etc. Navigate to Prices tab You can manually add Discounts and Surcharges here You want this to be populated automatically. Cause You have not set up any source of supply like contracts where you can specify discounts/ surcharges beforehand . Resolution Price conditions, including surcharges or discounts may be applied to the price charged for a product in a purchase order or contract. Price conditions are based on contracts, list prices, or product and supplier information and may have a fixed validity period. e.g. In contract -> items-> prices tab you can add the price components. When you create purchase order , system will look for available source of supply like contract, and if you have already set surcharge/discount in contract then it will pick automatically. See Also Help Documents: Create and Edit a Purchasing Contract Pricing in Supplier Relationship Management Discounts, Surcharges, and Scales in Prices Purchase Order Processing Keywords purchase order discount and surcharge, purchasing contract, source of supply, price components
response: Price conditions, including surcharges or discounts may be applied to the price charged for a product in a purchase order or contract. Price conditions are based on contracts, list prices, or product and supplier information and may have a fixed validity period. e.g. In contract -> items-> prices tab you can add the price components. When you create purchase order , system will look for available source of supply like contract, and if you have already set surcharge/discount in contract then it will pick automatically.

instruction: You are Unable to Find the Return to Supplier Document under Invoice Entry screen
input: Symptom You have created a return to supplier document and it has been released. When you want to invoice it in supplier invoicing work center, you are unable to find the document. Environment SAP Business ByDesign Reproducing the Issue Go to Supplier Invoicing work center Select Invoice Entry view Select option " All Returns to be Invoiced" from the drop-down Search with the Return ID No documents are displayed. Go to advanced filter Search with the return ID-> No records found Cause Once the return to supplier(RTS) is created, the system sends a message to Outbound Delivery Processing, this makes the RTS available in Delivery Proposals to create the Return To Supplier Outbound Delivery. It's really only when the associated Outbound Delivery gets released that the Supplier Invoice Request (SIR) is created in backend which makes it available for invoicing, making it visible in the Invoice Entry Screen. Hence, Invoicing is basically done with respect to delivery document. The invoice Entry Screen is based on the supplier invoice request which is based off the Outbound Delivery. This means that the supplier invoice request's base document ID will be the "Return to Supplier Delivery ID", not the Return to Supplier itself. Resolution Hence, the return filter works based on the relevant outbound delivery ID. See Also  https://blogs.sap.com/2016/05/18/return-to-supplier-processing/ Keywords return to supplier, outbound delivery, invoice entry, Return to Supplier Delivery ID, return to supplier not found
response: Hence, the return filter works based on the relevant outbound delivery ID.

Resolution In order to resolve the issue, Follow the below steps, While confirmation of production Make task Go to Production Control  Work Center Navigate to Task Control View  Search for Make task, lets say 200 Click Confirm Navigate to Confirmation tab and sub-tab Activities On field Confirmed Duration, maintain any duration manually, Press Enter Key click Save Now Finish the task  You should see Total Confirmed Duration showing with CHAR format & Actual Processing time in data source Resource Utilisation Keywords Total Confirmed Duration field in the Resource Utilisation data source shows field value as "PT0S",  You observe Field 'Total Confirmed Duration' in the Resource Utilisation data source shows as "PT0S" for Resource

instruction: Unit of measure is different in purchase order compared to preceding document
input: Symptom You notice that Unit of measure is not passed on to Purchase order from preceding document.  or You are unable to change the Unit of measure in Purchase order. Environment SAP Business ByDesign Cause Since you have maintained Unit of measure under purchasing tab of Product master data ,that is taken as default in the Purchase order.  or When you have free text items in Purchase order, system will take Unit of measure from preceding documents like Shopping cart or Purchase request. Resolution In general,while creating shopping cart or Purchase request or Purchase order etc 1.with Product ID or Service ID If a Physical unit of measure is maintained (for example days)in product master data then you will also get various respective Unit of measures(like  hours,months, years etc) to choose . If Trading unit of measure is maintained (for example each) in product master data then you will get only that unit of measure until unless you have maintained other quantity conversions in product master data. 2. Free text items. If a Physical unit of measure (for example days)is maintained in Preceding document then you will also get various respective Unit of measures(like  hours,months, years etc) to choose . If Trading unit of measure(for example each) is maintained in Preceding document then you will get only that unit of measure. See Also  2933978 - Purchase Order Created From Project Purchase Request is Changing the Unit of Measure 3061946 - Why is Unit of measure in Supplier invoice is different from that of Purchase order

If Trading unit of measure is maintained (for example each) in product master data then you will get only that unit of measure until unless you have maintained other quantity conversions in product master data. 2. instruction: Change Inventory Managed Indicator Not Possible; Logistics Area Not Empty
input: Symptom System is triggering error 'Change Inventory managed indicator not possible; logistics area not empty' when unchecking the flag Inventory Managed for a logistics area.  Environment SAP Business ByDesign Reproducing the Issue Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.  Navigate to the Locations view.  Select the relevant site/storage location and choose the Edit Layout button.  In the location layout, select the relevant logistics area and under the General sub-tab deselect the flag Inventory-managed. The system displays the above error message even if there is no stock in your logistics area. Cause There are child logistics areas under the logistics area for which Inventory Managed flag is trying to be unchecked.  Resolution To uncheck the Inventory Managed flag without errors it is necessary to make sure that there is no stock in the logistics area and all the child logistics areas under the said logistics area has to be deleted. Keywords Inventory managed, uncheck, logistics area, site, inventory managed flag enabled, disable inventory managed flag, location layout
response: To uncheck the Inventory Managed flag without errors it is necessary to make sure that there is no stock in the logistics area and all the child logistics areas under the said logistics area has to be deleted.

instruction: How to Handle Antidumping Duty in SAP Business ByDesign?
input: Symptom  You are unable to book the customs duty invoice due to missing Antidumping duty charges. Environment SAP Business ByDesign Reproducing the Issue Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center  Go to the Common Tasks Select Customs Duty Invoice Unable to capture Antidumping Duty Cause In the customs duty invoice, if you use the tax code 201- Import of Goods (Bill of entry), then you have countervelling duty under that. Currently antidumping duty is not supported. But in tax code 201, there is another tax type called Special countervelling duty. Resolution In the current release, Antidumping Duty not available in the customs duty invoice. It can be taken as a new requirement. Hence we have forwarded your request of the functionality of having "Antidumping Duty in customs duty invoice" as feedback to our product planning process. Feedback like this is highly appreciated as it helps to improve our product and services. Please post this idea in Influence site - https://influence.sap.com/feedback Keywords  Antidumping Duty, Customs duty invoice, Antidumping Duty in ByDesign

instruction: Error appears "Requesting of stock transfer proposal number  not possible" when trying to release Stock Transfer Proposal
input: Symptom You are trying to release Stock transfer proposal KLM for Product DEF/KM, error appears. *KLM refers to Stock transfer proposal number, *DEF refers to Product Id, *KM refers to planning area. Environment SAP Business ByDesign Reproducing the Issue Go to Supply Planning Work Center Go to Products View Select Open Product DEF/KM Planning Area Select  Stock transfer proposal KLM Select Release Error appears Requesting of stock transfer proposal number KLM not possible Cause The Location KM is the Ship-to location or the Planning area for the stock transfer proposal for which ship-to Location is not enabled. Resolution Kindly follow the below steps to resolve the issue. Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data Work Center Navigate to Locations View Search for Location KM Select Edit Navigate to General Tab Under roles, Enable ship-to Location  Select Save Keywords Requesting of stock transfer proposal number  not possible, when trying to release Stock Transfer Proposal, stock transfer proposal for which ship-to Location is not enabled

instruction: Display Transport Lane In Sales Order
input: Symptom You want the system to display selected transport lane information for a line item to be displayed in the Sales Order. Environment SAP Business ByDesign. Reproducing the Issue Go to Sales Orders work center.  Navigate to the Sales Orders view.  Search for the relevant sales order and choose the button Assign Source of Supply.  You want to see the relevant transport lane information also in the select sources of supply window.  Cause The sales order displays information to the seller who needs to confirm the delivery date and the ship-from location. The details of transport lane etc are provided to the logistics team which works on the customer demand.  Resolution You will be able to see the transport lane information only in the customer demand screen and not in the sales order screen. Keywords transport lane, sales order, customer demand, view transport lane in sales order, transport lane information in sales order
response: You will be able to see the transport lane information only in the customer demand screen and not in the sales order screen.

instruction: How to print New Inventory Adjustment
input: Symptom You would like to know how to print or send by e-mail New Inventory Adjustment DEF*DEF refers to Physical Inventory Document id Environment SAP Business ByDesign Reproducing the Issue  Go to Physical Inventory Work Center  Go to By PI Count Document View Search for DEF Click View All Select Edit Output Settings You cant find print or send by e-mail New inventory adjustment Cause It is not possible to print the Physical Inventory Count document DEF but you can display this document in the Start of the navigation path Physical Inventory. instruction: Error appears "Time zone change not allowed;demand forecast exist for Site" when trying to Change the time zone of a Site
input: Symptom You are trying to change the time zone of a Site KLM, Error appears*KLM refers to Site Id/Planning Area id, *DEF refers to Product id. Environment SAP Business ByDesign Reproducing the Issue  Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data Work Center Go to Locations view Select 'Active Sites' in the dropdown list and search for Site/Location ID KLM Click Edit and scroll down to Additional Fields section In Time Zone field, change time zone as per your requirement  Select Save  You will see the following error messages: "Time zone change not allowed; demand forecast exist for site" "Save could not be executed" Cause As there is a Demand Forecast maintained for Product id DEF, Planning area id KLM. Resolution Kindly delete the demand forecast and then try to change the time zone. Steps to delete forecast Go to Supply Planning WorkCenter Navigate to Maintain Demand Forecast Maintain Product id & Period type  Select Go Select the Forecast maintained for Product id DEF/Planning Area id KLM Select Delete Keywords Time zone change not allowed; demand forecast exist for Site, Save could not be executed, Error appears "Time zone change not allowed; demand forecast exist for Site" when trying to Change the time zone of a Site
response: Kindly delete the demand forecast and then try to change the time zone. Steps to delete forecast Go to Supply Planning WorkCenter Navigate to Maintain Demand Forecast Maintain Product id & Period type  Select Go Select the Forecast maintained for Product id DEF/Planning Area id KLM Select Delete

instruction: Unable to delete attachment from Purchase order
input: Symptom Attachments for an item level in purchase order it is not possible to be deleted or replaced. Environment SAP Business ByDesign Reproducing the Issue Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center. Go to Purchase Orders view. Filter for All Purchase Orders. Search for ABC and open it (ABC represents the Purchase Order ID). Navigate to the Items tab. Navigate to the Attachments sub-tab. Check the Delete and Replace button are grayed out. Cause System is working as expected. While Purchase Order is still is Preparation, it is possible to delete/replace attachments, however, when the Purchase Order is Sent, you're not allowed to delete/replace, just to add new ones. Resolution An option to be able to be allowed, you can follow the steps below: Go to the Implementation Projects. Step 4. Compliance. Corporate Governance. Highlight the 'Audit' section and you will see one question on the right hand side of screen. "Do you want to enable Audit Proof Archiving?" Select it. Also, since attachment type is standard it gets included by default to the output, so either you can use document type as internal if you don't want to send to Supplier or you can uncheck it in the "You can also"-> edit output settings for purchase order. Please refer KBA 2398329 - System hangs or Crashes When Trying To Open/view Details under Output History tab. Keywords Attachments; Purchase Order; Items; Delete; Replace; Audit
response: An option to be able to be allowed, you can follow the steps below: Go to the Implementation Projects. Step 4. Compliance. Corporate Governance. Highlight the 'Audit' section and you will see one question on the right hand side of screen. "Do you want to enable Audit Proof Archiving?" Select it. Also, since attachment type is standard it gets included by default to the output, so either you can use document type as internal if you don't want to send to Supplier or you can uncheck it in the "You can also"-> edit output settings for purchase order. Please refer KBA 2398329 - System hangs or Crashes When Trying To Open/view Details under Output History tab.

instruction: Purchase Order Returns To Not Delivered Status When a Return With Follow Up decision 'Credit Memo' is created.
input: Symptom When a Return with follow-up decision 'Credit Memo' is created for a purchase order item (all ordered quantity), the purchase order item is still not Finished. Environment SAP Business ByDesign Reproducing the Issue Go to the Purchase Orders work center. Go to the Purchase Orders view. Search and open the Purchase Order ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Purchase Order). Go to Items tab. See that the Delivery Status is Not Delivered, and Invoicing Status is Not Invoiced. Cause Once the Return to Supplier is created and the Outbound Delivery is Released, the system updates the Purchase Order item status to Sent. This is because returning delivered products does not mean finishing the order. It only means the delivered part (or all) is no longer needed. Delivery is still required for the returned part (or all). This works the same for invoicing status. Note: if Delivery Status OR Invoicing Status is Manually Finished after the return and credit memo are created, the status of the item will become Follow-up Document Created. Resolution This is the expected behavior. For this case, we suggest to manually Finish the Delivery and Invoice status of the purchase order. This can be done as per following steps: Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center. Navigate to the Purchase Orders view. Search and select the purchase order document you have returned. Under the Items section choose the Finish button. You have the option to select Invoice and Delivery in the Finish button. Select the relevant option to manually finish Delivery and Invoice. See Also  2732939 - Purchase Order Available For Delivery After Supplier Return Keywords Purchase Order, Return to Supplier, Credit Memo, Not Delivered, Follow-up Document Created
response: This is the expected behavior. For this case, we suggest to manually Finish the Delivery and Invoice status of the purchase order. Under the Items section choose the Finish button. You have the option to select Invoice and Delivery in the Finish button. Select the relevant option to manually finish Delivery and Invoice.

instruction: Approval Process Does Not Activate.
input: Symptom You have set up an approval process for your documents such as purchase orders or supplier invoice. One of the approval steps of this process states that if a particular field of this document contains this data " ABC-DEF", an approver will be requested by the system. However, and despite the correct field maintain with "ABC-DEF" in the document, the above approval process does not get triggered. Environment SAP Business ByDesign Reproducing the Issue Go to Work Center Application and User Management. Select the view Approval Processes. Select the needed approval process and the specific step in it. From here, you make sure that one condition defines that if a certain field contains " ABC-DEF", an approver will be requested by the system. Now, you create a document and see that the needed field is correctly maintained with "ABC-DEF". After completing and saving the document, you realize that this specific approval rule did not get triggered. Cause When maintaining specific conditions in your approval process rules, it is easy to avoid typo such as "ABC-DEG" instead of "ABC-DEF". However, by mistake, an extra space can be added in the approval rules: " ABC-DEF" instead of "ABC-DEF". This can be the reason why no approver get triggered in that case. Resolution Please make sure that no extra space is present in your approval processes rules when not needed. Keywords Approval Processes, Extra Space, Approvers, Approval Definition, Approval Rules
response: Please make sure that no extra space is present in your approval processes rules when not needed.

instruction: How Tax Net Base Amount is Calculated?

instruction: No Separate Field for House Number in the Purchase Order IDOC
input: Symptom No separate Field for House No. in the Purchase Order IDOC. So, if address has more than 35 characters in the Idoc, system cuts off all other characters. Environment SAP Business ByDesign Reproducing the Issue Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center. Go to the Purchase Orders view. Search and open the Purchase Order ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Purchase Order). Click on the View All button. Go to the Items tab. Go to the Delivery sub-tab. See that the House No./Street display on separate fields. Go to the Application and User Management work center. Go to the Business Communication Monitoring view. Click on the Advanced filter. Filter by All Business Messages and Document ID ABC. Click on Go. Select the Purchase Order ABC. Click on the Arrow > Show Payload > IDOC. Here the IDOC displays Street and House no. is in one Field (STRAS) and if the character limit is reached, then the system cuts off remaining characters. Cause  Currently we only concatenate House ID and street Name and put it in the STRAS field. Resolution It is not guaranteed that IDOC maps all address fields available in the BYD XML payload to the IDOC payload. For the address, the IDOC payload has only 2 fields capable of holding street address STRAS and STRS2 both of which are 35 char long. Whereas in ByD we have House ID, Street Name, Address line 1, address line 2 address line 3 and so on. So, it is not possible to get all the address info available in BYD into the IDOC fields. Keywords IDOC, Purchase Order, House number, Address, STRAS
response: It is not guaranteed that IDOC maps all address fields available in the BYD XML payload to the IDOC payload. For the address, the IDOC payload has only 2 fields capable of holding street address STRAS and STRS2 both of which are 35 char long. Whereas in ByD we have House ID, Street Name, Address line 1, address line 2 address line 3 and so on. So, it is not possible to get all the address info available in BYD into the IDOC fields.

instruction: Not All The Components Are Copied When Creating a Copy of The Selected BoM Variant to a New BoM
input: Symptom You are creating a copy of the existing BoM XYZ (XYZ represents the exact ID of the BoM) variant to a new BoM. However, the line item 30 (we will use this as an example to expain this behaviour) is not copied in the new BoM. Environment SAP Business ByDesign Reproducing the Issue Go to the Work centre "Planning and Production Master Data".  Select the View "Production Bills of Material". Find the BoM XYZ.  Click the button "Copy".  Result: you can see that line item 30 is not present in the created copy of the BoM. Cause When you open the original BoM, you will see that there are two records for the line item 30. One of them is for the product ABC (ABC represents the exact ID of the product) and the other one for the product DEF (DEF represents the exact ID of the product).  The product ABC is assigned to a Variant 1 (which we want to copy) and the subsequently created product DEF is assigned to Variant 2. In such cases, you need to create a new line item with the new product DEF because if you use the same line item ID for two different products, then the system will substitute the existing line item with the new one (product) even if same is still valid. Resolution This is the correct and expected behaviour of the system. The product from the original variant will only be transferred to the new variant if no new product is added to its line ID. Keywords bill of materials, bom, production, copy
response: This is the correct and expected behaviour of the system. The product from the original variant will only be transferred to the new variant if no new product is added to its line ID.

instruction: Quantity Difference Between the Inbound Delivery and the Inbound Delivery Detailed Line Items Report

instruction: Possible Duplicate Exception With Supplier Invoice Uploaded Via Excel
input: Symptom  Supplier Invoices created via excel upload are displaying the exception 'Possible Duplicate'. Environment SAP Business ByDesign Reproducing the Issue Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center. Go to the Invoices and Credit Memo view. Search and open the Supplier Invoice ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Supplier Invoice). Click on the View All button. Go to the Exceptions tab.  System displays the Exception 'Possible Duplicate' and it is already Obsoleted. Supplier Invoice status is then Ready for Posting. Cause In the Business Configuration activity 'Supplier Invoice Exceptions' > 'Possible Duplicate', the External Document ID - Similarity (%) is defined as 80%. The External Document IDs of the Supplier Invoices that system is detecting as possible duplicate are very similar. Hence the exception is raised. Resolution We suggest to adjust the 'External Document ID - Similarity (%)' to 100% to prevent this exception from happening while uploading the Supplier Invoices via excel. The configuration can be maintained as per following steps: Go to the Business Configuration work center. Go to the Overview view. Search and open the Supplier Invoice Exceptions activity. Select Possible Duplicate as Exception type. Change the External Document ID - Similarity (%) field to 100%. Once this configuration is maintained, the exception should not occur for these cases that the External Document ID is very similar. Keywords Possible Duplicate, Exception, Supplier Invoice, Excel
response: We suggest to adjust the 'External Document ID - Similarity (%)' to 100% to prevent this exception from happening while uploading the Supplier Invoices via excel. The configuration can be maintained as per following steps: Go to the Business Configuration work center. Go to the Overview view. Search and open the Supplier Invoice Exceptions activity. Select Possible Duplicate as Exception type. Change the External Document ID - Similarity (%) field to 100%. Once this configuration is maintained, the exception should not occur for these cases that the External Document ID is very similar.

instruction: Pick Task quantity & Delivery Request Quantity is higher than Requested Quantity of Sales Order
input: Symptom You observe Sales order KLM created for m quantity of product DEF, However in the delivery request and Pick Task Delivery Quantity is n.*KLM refers to Sales Order id, m refers to quantity defined in Sales Order, DEF refers to Product id, n refers to quantity populated in Delivery Request and Pick Task. Environment SAP Business ByDesign Reproducing the Issue Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center Navigate to Delivery Requests View Search for Sales Order KLM  You observe Delivery Request  quantity is n, However Sales Order quantity is m Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center Navigate to Task Control View Search for Pick Task You observe Pick Task quantity is n, However Sales Order quantity is m Cause During confirmation of pick task User entered n quantity instead of m quantity which resulted in quantity populating n in Total Requested Quantity in Outbound Delivery Request  Warehouse Request, Warehouse Order & Pick Task. Resolution In Pick Task, User is allowed to enter over and above requested quantity, there is no hard stop here, Hence Pick Task quantity n & Delivery Request Quantity n is higher than Requested Quantity of Sales Order m. This is the standard behavior as designed. Keywords Pick Task quantity, Delivery Request Quantity,  higher, Sales Order, sales order quantity
response: In Pick Task, User is allowed to enter over and above requested quantity, there is no hard stop here, Hence Pick Task quantity n & Delivery Request Quantity n is higher than Requested Quantity of Sales Order m. This is the standard behavior as designed.

instruction: "System Maintenance / Temporary System Downtime" Error When Trying to Create a New List Price
input: Symptom Dump message "System Maintenance / Temporary System Downtime" when trying to create a New List Price. Environment SAP Business ByDesign Reproducing the Issue Go to the Product Portfolio work center. Go to the New List Price common task. On the screen: 1 Define Settings, add the necessary data, including Supplier, Company and Product Category. Click on Next button. The system shows loading bubbles, and after 10 minutes loading it shows a dump message. Cause The error message shown is regarding a time-out issue. It is triggered because the Product Category selected on the scenario has a large number of Products related to it. Since there is a large amount of products trying to load to the next screen, the result is a time-out error. instruction: Error in Credit Memo: The sum of credit amounts is greater than the sum of debit amounts for the preceding supplier invoice item
input: Symptom You encountered following error in Credit Memo even though the quantity or amount did not exceed the total quantity and amount of preceding supplier invoice: "The sum of credit amounts is greater than the sum of debit amounts for the preceding supplier invoice item". Environment SAP Business ByDesign Reproducing the Issue Go to Supplier Invoicing work center  Select view: Invoices and Credit Memos Search for the Credit Memo which is in exception Select View All Navigate to Exceptions tab Error: The sum of credit amounts is greater than the sum of debit amounts for the preceding supplier invoice item Cause In cost distribution of the credit memo, the reference item is invoice id-line item (e.g. XXX.1) Here XXX refers to preceding supplier invoice id and 1 refers to the line item. In the supplier invoice cost distribution, the reference item (XXX.1) shows amount less than the amount in the credit memo. This is why the error occurs in the credit memo. Resolution Please change the amount in the Credit Memo to the original reference amount as specified in the Supplier Invoice reference. See Also 1961534 - Cannot Post Credit Memo. instruction: How to retrieve Code List for the Element OutputRequestFormTemplateCode (ManageGoodTags) Using the Webservice II_QUERY_CODE_LIST_IN
input: Symptom You are using the web service "ManageGoodTags" to create labels, but you are unable to choose the output forms from the web service. response: A sample payload (for English language code) would be: <n0:CodeListByIDQuery_sync xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global"> <CodeListSelectionByID> <SelectionByCodeDataType> <Name>OutputRequestFormTemplateCode</Name> <NamespaceURI>http://sap.com/xi/AP/Common/GDT</NamespaceURI> </SelectionByCodeDataType> <SelectionByLanguageCode>EN</SelectionByLanguageCode> </CodeListSelectionByID> </n0:CodeListByIDQuery_sync> You can find further explanation on how to use this query in this blog post: https://blogs.sap.com/2015/03/12/how-to-get-bydesign-code-lists-via-web-service/

instruction: Cannot Add Location to Logistics Task Folder
input: Symptom You are unable to add the Location YYY to the Logistics Task Folder XXX. XXX - Logistics Task Folder ID. YYY - Location ID. Environment SAP Business ByDesign. Select Task Assignment Criteria tab.  Select Storage Location.  Click Add Item for Included Items.  Enter the Location YYY.  Click Ok.  Nothing happens and the Location is not added. instruction: The Ship-To Address is Incorrect in Shopping Cart
input: Symptom You have updated the address in the organizational management work center. Then you created a shopping cart and entered the org unit which is marked as ship-to location. The updated address is not displayed in the shopping cart. Environment  SAP Business ByDesign Reproducing the Issue Go to Home work center Select Self Services-> Shopping Cart(advanced) Enter the employee name and enter ship-to location manually The updated address is not correctly displayed on the shopping cart screen Cause The ship-to location address is not updated in the site master data. Resolution You can maintain this in the work center Supply chain Design Master data work center-> Locations view-> All sites-> search for the site and edit OR You can go to Organizational work center-> Edit Org Structures->search for the respective org unit-> Definitions tab-> Under Business Residence, select Associated Site and open the site hyperlink. This will open the site master data where you can update the correct address. See Also 2779030 - Error message:Location XXX not found as ship-to location  Keywords ship-to address, shopping cart, Supply chain Design Master data, location, org structure, associated site

instruction: Error while creating new payment term --Net due date is missing
input: Symptom You get this error while creating new payment term. Environment SAP Business ByDesign Reproducing the Issue Go to Business configuration work center Go to  implementation Projects view Go to fine tune activity Search for Activity Suppliers Click Define Payment Terms for Procurement Click Add row Enter the  payment term ID starting with Z Enter the description Enter the days in the field"Number of Days After Invoice Date / Receipt Date (1)" or in the field" Number of Days After Invoice Date / Receipt Date (2)" under discount rate 1 granted or discount rate 2 granted respectively. Click Save Cause We understand that in the standard payment terms with description"End of Month of Invoice Date, XX days", you notice that details maintained under "Discount Rate 1 Granted" the Number of Days After Invoice Date / Receipt Date(1) is maintained and under "net due price" , fixed day of month is maintained. However it is currently a limitation as you cannot maintain the same in Z payment terms because we do not allow the calculation to be as "End of Month of Invoice Date, XX days". Instead we do allow the format "XX days from Invoice Date, End of month" Resolution Currently in Z payment terms If you enter details under discount rate with Number of Days After Invoice Date / Receipt Date, then it is mandatory to maintain the Number of Days After Invoice Date / Receipt Date under 'net due price' as well. If you enter details under discount rate with fixed day of month, then it is mandatory to maintain the fixed day of month under 'net due price' as well. If you enter details under discount rate with additional month, then it is mandatory to maintain the additional month under 'net due price' as well. You may refer the help document on how the calculation works in various scenarios of payment terms https://help.sap.com/viewer/0635ec3491974ad988be05d6b1dcf734/2008/en-US/e7bd583ad81c4f12ba1cb535f4a8f2a2.html?q=Payment%20terms Keywords Issue while creating new payment term

If you enter details under discount rate with fixed day of month, then it is mandatory to maintain the fixed day of month under 'net due price' as well. instruction: Serial Number Profile Changes the Generation of Production Tasks
input: Symptom You change the Serial Number Profile for one of your Input Products of a production to Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Processes. After this change, two Make Tasks are generated from Production Order XXX. As the Task-Generation Method set in Production Model is Operation including Reporting Point and there is no reporting point set, you expect only one Make Task. Before the change in Serial Number Profile, only one Make Task was created. XXX = Production Order ID Environment SAP Business ByDesign Reproducing the Issue Go to Production Control work center. Select Task Control view. Search for Production Order ID XXX. Notice that two Make Tasks are generated. Cause When the input products are assigned to a certain activity the confirmation is assigned as Backflush, then system will assign the components to the task which is having the reporting point (after that activity), as the backflush quantity is determined by reporting quantity. The confirmation is assigned as Explicit, then system will assign the components to the task, which is having that activity. When the products are not serialized and the confirmation method is maintained as the Backflush, system assigned the components to last task (which is associated with reporting point), independent of their individual assignments to activities in production model. When we change the Serial Number Profile to Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Processes, components become serialized. Serialized products will always be considered as Explicit (even if in production model the confirmation method is maintained as Backflush), as system cannot backflush the quantities by auto determining Serial Numbers. Since they are considered Explicit, system respects the activity assignment in production model. Resolution As the Confirmation Method is different for serialized products, the system is working as designed. Keywords Serial, Number, Production
response: As the Confirmation Method is different for serialized products, the system is working as designed.

instruction: Error appears "Line item 1: Logistics area XXX not valid -----> Inventory in logistics area not available" when trying to confirm replenish task
input: Symptom You are trying to confirm a Replenishment Task for a requested quantity DEF (DEF refers to Replenish Task id), but system is displaying error even though Stock is available in Stock Overview for the relevant Product. Environment SAP Business ByDesign Reproducing the Issue Navigate to Internal Logistics work center Go to Task Control View Search for the relevant Task ID Click the Confirm button Enter the Actual quantity The following error appears: Line item 1: Logistics area XXX not valid -----> Inventory in logistics area not available Cause This is a valid error as there is not sufficient stock available to confirm the replenishment task. We should also check stock situation in planning screen by calculating Total Demand - Total Supply to understand if the stock is available. Resolution You either have to cancel the existing allocated demand or you will have to have sufficient stock available to the confirm task. Note: This error is applicable for all Site Logistics  & Internal Logistics Tasks. Keywords Logistics area XXX not valid, Inventory in logistics area not available, replenishment task
response: You either have to cancel the existing allocated demand or you will have to have sufficient stock available to the confirm task. Note: This error is applicable for all Site Logistics  & Internal Logistics Tasks.

instruction: How to restrict access of an user from creating or seeing a document
input: Symptom You wanted to stop an user from seeing or creating a document like a Supplier Invoice or Purchase order which belongs to a particular Org Unit, or you wanted to stop an user from seeing and editing a project that was created by another user.  or  Want to know why a user cannot see a Particular project. Environment SAP Business ByDesign Cause Access restrictions Resolution Go to Application and User Management work center. Go to Business Users view. Search and select the user. click on edit and choose access rights. Go to the Access Restrictions tab. Find the work center view SRM_invoice entry (Or any other view related to Supplier Invoice or Purchase order). On the right-side you have two columns called Read Access and Write Access. There you choose "restricted". Then scroll down and go to sub tab detailed Restriction. Under Access group column you will see all available Org Units. For which ever access should be given, you have check mark the respective read and write access check box. Which ever are not check marked, they will have no access. Note: What ever appears under access group that is what is currently allowed to be used to restrict. For example, for Project you will see employee id's(Person responsible for project) appearing under access group and not companies. See Also  2839450 - How to Restrict Users from Accessing your Project?  3094553 - Access restriction is not working for projects Keywords remove access; stop creating; remove access of a user to create Purchase orders of particular company

instruction: Supplier Invoice Scanning Keyword Settings is Not Supported for New Intelligent PDF Scanning Functionality
input: Symptom You have maintained Keyword settings for scanned invoice in the Business Configuration activity, however when you are scanning the PDF documents using the new intelligent PDF scanning functionality, data is not uploaded as expected. Environment SAP Business ByDesign Reproducing the Issue In Business Configuration, you have maintained keyword(e.g. document type as credit memo) Go to Supplier Invoicing work center Select view Invoice Scanning Scan the PDF document which is a credit memo and upload it The invoice data is not uploaded as expected. You scanned a credit memo, but document is created as scanned invoice. Cause Keyword settings are only meant to be useful for extracting the data from the text file which is used when you upload the scanned invoice using collaboration tool where both text and PDF files are used. Resolution "Supplier Invoice Scanning Keyword Settings" is not supported for intelligent PDF scanning functionality. Please use the collaboration window for scanning in such cases. See Also  2959747 - Credit memo not supported with new intelligent PDF scanning Keywords Supplier Invoice Scanning Keyword Settings, keywords not detected, intelligent PDF scanning
response: "Supplier Invoice Scanning Keyword Settings" is not supported for intelligent PDF scanning functionality. Please use the collaboration window for scanning in such cases.

instruction: Missing Party ID in Intrastat Declaration for UK
input: Symptom You have created the Intrastat Declaration ABC but you can see that for some lines, the Party ID is missing. Environment SAP Business ByDesign Reproducing the Issue Go to work center Intrastat. Select the view Intrastat Declarations. Search and open the intrastat declaration ABC. Go to Items tab. From here you might see that for some lines, the field Party ID is empty. Cause -1 -Party ID is never a part of Intrastat Declaration for UK as per specification. If this is a legal change, please contact your partner. The minimum required data that needs to be reported as part of the intrastat declaration includes: VAT number Whether intra-EU import or export Commodity code The partner Member State Value and quantity of the goods The nature of the transaction, e.g. direct sales, purchases, returns -2-However, if the nature of transaction is "Transactions having actual or intended change of ownership for a consideration", the field PartyID might get populated. But if the nature of transaction is "Goods movements not relevant for VAT return (excise or fiscal warehouse)", the party ID field will not get populated. Resolution Please refer to this blog to check what fields are mandatory in your intrastat declaration in UK: https://blogs.sap.com/2020/03/03/intrastat-declarations-in-sap-business-bydesign/ Keywords Intrastat Declaration, UK, Party ID.
response: Please refer to this blog to check what fields are mandatory in your intrastat declaration in UK: https://blogs.sap.com/2020/03/03/intrastat-declarations-in-sap-business-bydesign/

instruction: Wrong Tax code in Inter company Supplier invoice
input: Message Strip Error Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them. Symptom ***Archive Reason: Duplicate of KBA 2335218*** You expect a different tax code in the intercompany supplier invoice. Environment SAP Business ByDesign Reproducing the Issue Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view Select the relevant Intercompany Invoice which was created automatically by system based on customer invoice You can see that Tax Code is wrong Cause In general Intercompany supplier invoice details will be based on corresponding customer invoice. When tax determination happens at supplier invoice end separately then Automatic tax determination flag is checked in supplier invoice. As you know Tax Code = Tax Event + Tax type + TAX Rate Type + tax Deductibility. Where tax event is mainly depended on on Ship from and ship to . In Intercompany supplier invoice, Ship From and Ship To address is fetched from Location address maintained in Supply chain design master data work center. Resolution Go to Supply chain design master data work center Go to Locations view Search for Ship from and later Ship to  Select and Click on edit Enter the Address ,where Country and correct Postal code has to be maintained. See Also 2335218 - Wrong tax Code in Intercompany Supplier Invoice  2478712 - Tax Code is not Determined or Wrong Tax Code is Determined   2763883 - Incorrect Tax Code and Tax Country Defaulted in Supplier Invoice for Service Item
response: Go to Supply chain design master data work center Go to Locations view Search for Ship from and later Ship to  Select and Click on edit Enter the Address ,where Country and correct Postal code has to be maintained.

instruction: Error appears "Change logistics use not possible;logistics area not empty;Save could not be executed" while setting  logistics use as Not relevant for planning
input: Symptom When trying to set Logistics use as "Not Relevant for planning" for Logistics Area KLM, system throws the below error messages. (KLM refers to Logistics Area) "Change logistics use not possible; logistics area not empty;" "Save could not be executed" Environment SAP Business ByDesign Reproducing the Issue Navigate to Supply Chain Design Master Data Workcenter. Go to Locations View. Search for Logistics Area KLM. Select Logistics Use as "Not relevant for planning". Errors below appear: "Change logistics use not possible; logistics area not empty;" "Save could not be executed" Cause There could be 2 causes: Stock still exists in Logistics Area KLM. If any tasks from Workcenter (Outbound Logistics, Internal Logistics, Inbound Logistics, Production Control, Quality Planning) which are open for Logistics area KLM. Resolution Stock needs to be moved from Logistics Area KLM to some other Logistics Area via (Internal Logistics -> Goods Movement). Open Tasks that exist from Work center (Outbound Logistics, Internal Logistics, Inbound Logistics, Production Control, Quality Planning) need to be processed. To check any open tasks from Workcenter (Outbound Logistics, Internal Logistics, Inbound Logistics): Go to Outbound Logistics/Internal Logistics/Inbound Logistics Workcenter. Navigate to Task Control View. Select Open Advanced Filter. Select Task Status as "Not Started" & "In Process". Select Go. Note: It is necessary to check for Inspection tasks and count tasks as well to make sure that the above mentioned error is not displayed. See Also 3417212 - Unable to Add Logistics Use "Not Relevant for Planning" for a Logistics Area Due to Error "Change logistics use not possible; logistics area not empty". Keywords Change logistics use not possible; logistics area not empty, Save could not be executed, to set Logistics use as "Not Relevant for planning" for Logistics Area
response: Stock needs to be moved from Logistics Area KLM to some other Logistics Area via (Internal Logistics -> Goods Movement). Open Tasks that exist from Work center (Outbound Logistics, Internal Logistics, Inbound Logistics, Production Control, Quality Planning) need to be processed. To check any open tasks from Workcenter (Outbound Logistics, Internal Logistics, Inbound Logistics): Go to Outbound Logistics/Internal Logistics/Inbound Logistics Workcenter. Navigate to Task Control View. Select Open Advanced Filter. Select Task Status as "Not Started" & "In Process". Select Go. Note: It is necessary to check for Inspection tasks and count tasks as well to make sure that the above mentioned error is not displayed.

instruction: Accuracy of Intelligent Invoice Scanning
input: Symptom In the Invoice Scanning view of the Supplier Invoicing work center, you upload supplier invoice documents in PDF format for creating supplier invoices in the system. But some of the scanned value is not correctly recognized. Environment SAP Business ByDesign All Versions Post 2008 Reproducing the Issue Go to Supplier Invoicing work center Go to Invoice Scanning view Click Upload In the new screen, select Company and PDF file, Start Process Go back to Invoice Scanning screen, wait till the status of the new invoice change to Scanning Completed Click Create Invoice You see some of the scanned values are not correctly recognized. Cause There are multiple reasons may cause accuracy issues. 1.The quality of the PDF file. If the PDF file is blurred, it may cause accuracy issues when scanning. 2.The content of the invoice is unclear or too complex. For example, since many different currencies use same symbol "$", if there is only symbol but no currency description maintained in the PDF invoice, system may propose a different currency than you expected. 3.Invoice scanning is based on a pre-trained model based on invoices we used to train the model. As of now, the accuracy may varies between invoice to invoice and not necessarily 100%. Hence there is a provision for user to review and modify the scanned values before creating invoice. The model will keep getting trained and the efforts will be on to increase the accuracy of scanned results. Resolution Please review the scanned invoice before creating invoice. Go to Supplier Invoicing work center Go to Invoice Scanning view Select the scanned invoice Click Review Here you can modify the scanned values. See Also Help Document Intelligent Invoice Scanning Quick Guide, Supported Languages and Countries Keywords Intelligent Invoice Scanning, PDF Scanning Invoice, PDF Invoice Scanning, PDF Supplier Invoice, Scanned Invoice
response: Please review the scanned invoice before creating invoice. Go to Supplier Invoicing work center Go to Invoice Scanning view Select the scanned invoice Click Review Here you can modify the scanned values.

instruction: ATP Shows Insufficient Quantity For a Product Which is Available on Stock
input: Symptom You have created a Sales Order containing the Product ABC (ABC represent the Product ID) which has enough on-hand quantity to fulfill the demand. However, when you check the availability (by clicking the respective button) the ATP indicator is displayed in yellow, showing late delivery. Environment SAP Business ByDesign Reproducing the Issue Go to the work centre Sales Orders.  Select the view Sales Orders.  Find the respective Sales Order.  Open it and go to the Items tab. Click the button Check Availability. Result:  Line Item 10 has an yellow ATP indicator: Late delivery; earliest delivery: XX.XX.XX (XX.XX.XX is the exact date in the future). Cause In the Product master data you have maintained an availability check scope: Stock. This means that the available stock is considered as available supply for the product availability check. There is a Goods Issue Processing Time also maintained for the product ABC. For instance, it is set to 48:00:00. Now, you think that the system will consider 2 calendar days.  However, this is not the case, as here the Site calendar and operating hours are taken into consideration.  If the respective Site has operating hours with Start Time being maintained as 8:00 and End Time 17:00 (for example), this means 8 operating hours per day. If you divide 48 (Goods Issue Processing Time) to 8 (Operating hours) this equals 6 working days. This 6 working days will be considered from the maintained Requested Date for the ATP to determine the earliest delivery for the product. Resolution This is the expected behaviour as per maintained product's master data. You could review the maintained Goods Issue Processing Time for the product ABC. Keywords ATP, insufficient, quantity, available, product, goods issue processing time,
response: This is the expected behaviour as per maintained product's master data. You could review the maintained Goods Issue Processing Time for the product ABC.
